Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts (rejects ETH).

Checked addition helper (c = a + b with require(c >= a)).
Checked subtraction helper (require(b <= a); c = a - b).
Checked multiplication helper (c = a * b with overflow require).
Checked division helper (require(b > 0); c = a / b).
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) on an untrusted caller-supplied contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary caller-supplied contract address.
Raw addition c = a + b in safeAdd prior to the overflow require.
Raw subtraction c = a - b in safeSub guarded only by require(b <= a).
Raw multiplication c = a * b in safeMul prior to the overflow require.
Raw division c = a / b in safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to owner, defining the privileged account.
Owned() constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
_newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership stages the pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, gating the ownership claim.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, changing privileged control.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
TAGCASH constructor sets the symbol state variable.
TAGCASH constructor sets the name state variable.
TAGCASH constructor sets the decimals state variable.
TAGCASH constructor sets _totalSupply to 100000000000000000000000000.
TAGCASH constructor credits the whole supply to the deployer address in balances.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply when computing the circulating supply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is used to index balances in balanceOf.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller identity directly controls the debited account.
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient.
to parameter determines the credited balance entry.
tokens parameter is the amount moved and checked by safeSub/safeAdd.
transfer invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance.
transfer invokes safeSub for the sender balance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], so the caller grants its own allowance.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
spender parameter becomes the second key of the allowance mapping.
tokens parameter is stored as the approved allowance value.
transferFrom debits and credits entries in the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender], tying the spend to the caller identity.
from parameter is the account debited by transferFrom.
to parameter is the account credited by transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for the sender balance and the allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is the first key read by allowance.
spender parameter is the second key read by allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external contract.
approveAndCall writes the allowed allowance mapping.
spender parameter is both the allowance key and the callee address.
tokens parameter is stored as allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
data parameter is arbitrary caller-supplied calldata forwarded to the external contract.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the caller-supplied spender contract before returning.
The untrusted spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall (or transferFrom) during receiveApproval with state not yet finalised.
onlyOwner restricts transferAnyERC20Token to the owner identified via msg.sender.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract address.
tokenAddress parameter selects the callee contract, only loosely constrained by onlyOwner.
tokens parameter is forwarded as the amount of the external transfer call.
owner state variable is read to authorise the rescue and used as the recipient.
owner is passed as the recipient argument of the external ERC20 transfer call.
Parameter a of safeAdd feeds the addition operation.
Parameter b of safeAdd feeds the addition operation.
safeAdd executes the raw addition c = a + b which can overflow before the require check.
Parameter a of safeSub feeds the subtraction operation.
Parameter b of safeSub feeds the subtraction operation.
safeSub executes c = a - b, an underflow-prone operation guarded only by require(b <= a).
Parameter a of safeMul feeds the multiplication operation.
Parameter b of safeMul feeds the multiplication operation.
safeMul executes the raw multiplication c = a * b which can overflow before the require check.
Parameter a of safeDiv feeds the division operation.
Parameter b of safeDiv feeds the division operation.
safeDiv executes c = a / b, a division guarded by require(b > 0).
